HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Overview of Home Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen Layouts and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Food Hygiene and Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Nutritive Value of Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
